# 80 Level

> > 80 Level is a premier industry platform for game developers, digital artists, and CGI/VFX specialists covering game engines, art techniques, and interactive media.

80 Level publishes in-depth technical articles, interviews, and case studies focused on game development pipelines, 3D art creation, visual effects, and emerging game technologies. The site covers major engines like Unreal Engine and Blender alongside indie game showcases and industry news.

## Key Topics

- Unreal Engine 5
- Blender
- Game Development
- 3D Art & Modeling
- Visual Effects (VFX)
- Indie Games
- Character Rigging
- Lighting & Rendering
- Shader Development
- Level Design
- Terrain Generation
- World Creator
- DLSS Technology
- Game Design
- Cyberpunk

## Game Engine Techniques & Tutorials

- [How Little Nightmares VR is Powered by Unity, Lighting, and Design](https://80.lv/articles/how-little-nightmares-vr-is-powered-by-unity-lighting-and-spatial-design): Iconik breaks down Unity, lighting, and design techniques for Little Nightmares VR development.
- [How to Sculpt & Texture a Greatsword with a Realistic and Alive Look](https://80.lv/articles/how-to-sculpt-and-texture-a-greatsword-with-a-realistic-and-alive-look): Kirill Muslimov's Blender workflow for sculpting and texturing realistic greatsword game assets.
- [The Making Of 2D-Looking 3D Smoke](https://80.lv/articles/how-to-achieve-a-2d-look-with-3d-smoke): Sil Roosenstein's approach to creating stylized 2D-looking 3D smoke effects and VFX.
- [Previs & Layout in KPop Demon Hunters](https://80.lv/articles/see-how-previs-layout-were-done-in-kpop-demon-hunters): Sony Pictures Imageworks' Unreal Engine previs and layout techniques for KPop Demon Hunters.
- [Customizable Stylized Water Shader For Unreal Engine 5](https://80.lv/articles/grab-this-stylized-water-shader-for-ue5): Jean-Baptiste Louis' customizable stylized water shader project for Unreal Engine 5.
- [Artist Shows a Horror Lighting Study Using a Hinako Fan Model](https://80.lv/articles/artist-shows-a-ue5-horror-lighting-study-featuring-hinako-from-silent-hill-f): Horror lighting study in Unreal Engine 5 featuring Silent Hill f character with atmospheric design.

## 3D Character & Asset Creation

- [Detailed Chun-Li Blender Rig With Many Expressions](https://80.lv/articles/ultra-expressive-street-fighter-s-chun-li-blender-rig-showcase): A$AP BERG's detailed Chun-Li Blender rig with facial expressions and shapekeys.
- [Create Realistic Eyebrows, Eyelashes, & Beard with This Brush Pack](https://80.lv/articles/create-realistic-eyebrows-eyelashes-beard-with-this-brush-pack): Facial Hair IMM Curve pack review: 44 ZBrush brushes for realistic character hair creation.

## Game News & Industry Coverage

- [Crimson Desert Sells 2 Million Copies at Launch With Strong Reception](https://80.lv/articles/crimson-desert-sells-2-million-copies-at-launch-in-strong-debut): Pearl Abyss' Crimson Desert launches successfully with 2 million copies sold on PS5 Pro.
- [NVIDIA Explains How DLSS 5 Honors Artistic Intent](https://80.lv/articles/nvidia-says-dlss-5-was-designed-with-developers-they-have-creative-control): NVIDIA discusses DLSS 5 design philosophy and developer creative control in rendering.
- ["Just Pretend We Didn't Announce It": Todd Howard on Elder Scrolls 6](https://80.lv/articles/just-pretend-we-didn-t-announce-it-todd-howard-on-keeping-balance-with-the-elder-scrolls-6-news): Todd Howard interview on Elder Scrolls 6 announcement strategy and Bethesda's approach.

## World Building & Terrain Tools

- [World Creator 2026.3 Now Allows You to Use Real-World Elevation Data](https://80.lv/articles/world-creator-2026-3-now-allows-you-to-use-real-world-elevation-data-in-its-system): World Creator 2026.3 update adds real-world elevation data support for terrain generation.

- [Diablo 2 Gets First-Person Makeover By Solo Dev In UE5](https://80.lv/articles/solo-developer-recreates-diablo-2-as-first-person-game-in-ue5): Solo developer converts Diablo 2 to first-person action RPG in Unreal Engine 5.
